summary: Frontend-only test of Admin AI Konsultant → Söhbətlər unviewed chat coloring and SlowReplyBar dismiss. All 4 acceptance criteria PASS.
critical_code_review_comments: AiConsultantTab.tsx is a very large component; consider splitting the sessions list, transcript viewer, knowledge/settings tabs into subcomponents to improve maintainability.

There are recurring Firestore 'WebChannelConnection RPC Listen transport errored / could not reach Firestore' warnings during initial navigation. Preview infra likely transient, but consider adding retry/backoff or graceful UI state.
Debug console.log statements (ProductService.getAll - userRole..., 'Admin Panel - Loading data...') are still printing in production build; recommend stripping for release.
ERR_BLOCKED_BY_RESPONSE.NotSameOrigin console error on some resource — please audit external asset loading (likely CORS/image).
test_credentials: localStorage userRole=admin, userId=test-admin; AI Konsultant section did not prompt password in this run.
seed_data_creation: None. Cleared only localStorage 'dv_admin_chat_seen_v1' before test to start from a clean unviewed state as instructed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: (a) On empty localStorage all 193 session rows had bg-blue-50 border-l-blue-500 and a data-testid='session-unviewed-<id>' dot. (b) After clicking session A (12a10fac-360a-4b02-bda5-0d28ce29c28b) then session B (08d1db94-8feb-47e9-9704-139375066f89): A's unviewed dot removed and class no longer contained bg-blue-50 (border-l-transparent); B was selected with bg-amber-50/70 border-l-amber-500. (c) localStorage 'dv_admin_chat_seen_v1' persisted timestamps for both IDs. (d) After full page reload and re-navigating to Söhbətlər, both A and B still had no unviewed dot (persistence confirmed) while never-clicked rows still displayed dots. (e) SlowReplyBar (data-testid='slow-reply-bar') was present; clicking data-testid='slow-reply-dismiss' hid the ENTIRE bar (query returned null afterwards) and it did not immediately reappear. Auto-hide 10s not explicitly awaited but dismiss behaviour verified as fixed.
rca of the issue: N/A — user-reported bugs (per-chat dismiss annoyance + no visual distinction for unviewed chats) are fixed. Unviewed detection via isSessionUnviewedByAdmin + markSessionViewedByAdmin (localStorage key dv_admin_chat_seen_v1) works; SlowReplyBar single-X dismiss and auto-hide behaviour implemented.
